title: TaskPrioritizationReport
description: The Task Prioritization agent's structured proposal. Validated by steps/task_prioritization_step.py against environment/queue.py: validate_ranking_proposal is a hard gate (ranked_task_ids must be an exact permutation of the pending task ids; score_breakdown must cover exactly those ids), is_ranking_score_consistent is a soft flag (ranking order should match descending final_score). On success this proposal is sent as-is to the resource_allocation mailbox (a2a/mailbox.py) as a task_ranking message.

ranked_task_ids.description: Must be exactly one permutation of the pending task ids from TaskQueueProfileFact.pending_tasks.
